moments.action: Lynn sits waiting under the strip lights, looking up; a woman in a white blazer with a staff lanyard stands over her, talking. By the last shot Lynn's blank stare has hardened into a wary one.
Wide on the library stacks: Lynn sits in a row of chairs beside another student. Insert of a phone opening a beach photo of a smiling girl and boy; back on Lynn, her eyes have dropped to the floor.
Through a glass wall Lynn watches Bank sit alone at a bare table with his jacket and a snack. She lifts her eyes, then the shot drifts out of focus onto an empty door frame and blurred shelves.
Bank answers questions in the white-walled room while Lynn stands at the glass watching. He stays level; she begins fixed on him and ends with her head lowered, turning away from the glass.
Lynn stands in profile against the bright window, eyes wet and jaw clenched; the film cuts from her face to a phone filling the frame with the beach snapshot of the smiling girl and boy.
